description:
Observations for productId + key, or one vectorId. Over 100 observations you get a
per-series summary. Pass sql to compute over every row (growth, averages, ranking)
server-side. Cite _sdmx_url.

format.description: csv: to save rows to a file, copy it verbatim. All observations (max 500), a row per series, a column per period; shared fields as '# name: value' lines.

full.description: Every observation (max 500) instead of a summary when over 100.

key.description: With productId: one code per dimension in position order, joined by '.'; '+' for OR ('1+2.2'); empty for all members ('.2', includes totals).

sql.description: One SELECT over all fetched rows as table 'data', returning only its result. Use it for growth, averages, rankings. Columns: one per dimension (non-alphanumerics → '_', double-quote them), period (TEXT), value (REAL), VECTOR_ID, UOM, STATUS.

vectorId.description: Instead of productId + key: one series.

name: get_sdmx_data
